caption: The drawing depicts a square-shaped patchwork design composed of triangular and rectangular sections. The quilt-like patchwork is bordered on the left and bottom edges with a green strip. Inside the border, the square is divided into four equal quadrants. Each quadrant contains a triangular section that alternates between two patterns: a red area with black vertical stripes, and a white area with thin black wavy horizontal lines. The overall effect is a geometric pattern with alternating red-striped and white-striped triangles, forming a pinwheel or hourglass design. The background of the image is an off-white color, and there is a handwritten note at the bottom right that reads “Elgin Monument Style.”
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
